name: AML.T0089 process-discovery record-boundary confusion
description: Attacker-controlled process-name or command-line fields carrying escaped delimiters/quotes desynchronize process-discovery record parsing, so a security-relevant process is merged, dropped, or misattributed and the agent trusts an incomplete AI-stack inventory.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:documentation|security test|fixture|code review|unit test|never execute|must reject|blocked|benign|do not trust)\b)(?=.*\b(?:ps|/proc(?:/\d+)?|tasklist|get-process|process(?:es)?\s+(?:list|table|discovery))\b)(?=.*(?:json|csv|tsv|record|row|line|field|delimiter|quote|escaped|\\n|\\r|newline|control))(?=.*(?:process\s*(?:name|command[- ]line)|comm|args|cmdline))(?=.*(?:merge|omit|drop|hide|truncate|misattribut|desync|shift|parse|parser|inventory))(?=.*(?:security|monitor|scanner|agent|ai|token|credential|backend)).*$
